Leather Notebook Covers

Every cover is cut to fit a Leuchtturm1917 or Moleskine notebook exactly, then saddle-stitched with Ritza 25 waxed thread on Seidel leather. The tolerances are tight enough that the notebook does not shift in the pocket, which is the diffrence between a cover that lasts and one that sags after a season of daily carry in a bag.

We use Seidel and Leuchtturm1917 names throughout because those are the products our customers actually carry, and Ritza thread because nothing else survives the same abrasion.
